name: Westminster sights
blurb: Over Westminster Bridge, past Big Ben, up Whitehall to Trafalgar Square, down The Mall to Buckingham Palace. Flat and full of detail.

name: Richmond Park loop
blurb: The classic London training loop on open park roads, with rolling climbs like Sawyer’s Hill.

name: Alpe d'Huez
blurb: The 21 hairpins from Bourg d’Oisans to the ski station. Long, steep and famous.
